acceptance_criteria: Exactly 3 C08 worlds and 4773 shared frames pass objective teacher eligibility and deterministic independent dual-scene equality; exactly 109969920 full-scan rays plus separately counted primary-only clearance/LOS qualification rays are preserved.
Exactly three hash-frozen M1D checkpoints run once on every frame: 14319 inference frames, zero training samples and zero optimizer steps.
Exactly 243 predeclared parameter tuples are evaluated for B0, M1D seeds 0/1/2 and GT oracle across all three worlds: 3645 graph replays.
Every graph edge retains positive physical traversal evidence; oracle connectivity and verified-edge correctness equal 1.0 for every grid row.

One tuple is frozen solely by mean C08 M1D composite score using weights 0.30 exit F1, 0.15 connectivity, 0.15 verified-edge correctness, 0.15 terminal reachability, 0.15 path-distance fidelity, 0.05 node-redundancy quality and 0.05 temporal-churn quality.
Zero C09, C10 and M-TARE reads; complete config, logs, manifests, sensor arrays, raw model outputs, sweep table, selected graphs, decision traces, metrics, previews and evidence seal are retained.
baseline: B0 range-sector baseline using only the current scan. GT oracle is an integrity upper bound, not a selectable method. Necessary fallback is STOP with evidence; no frame replacement, threshold relaxation, metric change or C09/C10 access is allowed.

estimated_cost.compute: CPU/Open3D dual-scene 109969920 full-scan rays, one RTX 5090 for three frozen inference passes, then CPU causal graph sweep; no training.

expected_evidence: Three Zarr sensor shards and three complete frame JSONL manifests with B0/oracle semantics and evaluator-only trace identity.
Nine compressed M1D output archives preserving direction logits, count/role probabilities and 128-D z_role.
One 3645-row parameter sweep, one frozen parameter JSON, fifteen selected graph snapshots, fifteen decision traces and method/world metrics.
Three complete-world objective-role trajectory figures, stage logs, environment/tool/input hashes, RUN_STATE and SHA-256 evidence seal.
method: Generate one deterministic 16x720 dual-scene LiDAR stream at all 4773 sealed 2m poses; preserve the objective 5m outgoing-direction, branch-count and 10m terminal-first role teacher for oracle/offline metrics; run frozen M1D seeds 0/1/2; feed B0, each M1D seed and GT oracle into the identical causal graph builder; sweep the predeclared 243 tuples and freeze one tuple by the mean predeclared composite over M1D seeds and C08 worlds only.
question: Can frozen M1D structural semantics causally build a trace-verified online topometric graph on the three C08 development worlds, and which one predeclared graph parameter tuple should be frozen before untouched C09 validation?
stop_conditions: Any geometry, trajectory, checkpoint, code or config hash drifts.
Any of 4773 frames is teacher-ineligible, nonfinite, below 0.8m horizontal clearance, branch-LOS incomplete or differs between the two CPU scenes by more than 1e-6m.
Any method receives GT edge/tunnel/world/future identity as a graph decision input, or any graph edge lacks positive physical trace evidence.
Oracle graph connectivity or verified-edge correctness is below 1.0 for any grid row.
Any need arises to change the data, grid, model, baseline, match radius, score weights, metric or acceptance criteria, or to read C09/C10/M-TARE.
